verdict.rationale: doola documents a first-party Formation MCP server that lets a founder form a Wyoming LLC from their own AI client with their own doola account, which is real natural-language operation of the product. The documented scope is narrow, though: one formation flow for one state, with no evidence that compliance, annual reports, EIN or registered-agent tasks can be driven conversationally. missing for 10: natural-language coverage beyond Wyoming LLC formation, detailed docs on the MCP tool set, independent or hands-on corroboration that the MCP flow works.
